name: Joy In Sufferings
overview: Scripture reveals that joy in sufferings is not only possible but commanded, as believers are called to rejoice even amid trials and tribulations. This joy arises from understanding that suffering produces patience and that present afflictions are incomparable to the future glory to be revealed in us. The apostle Paul exemplifies rejoicing in his own sufferings for the sake of the church, encouraging believers to remain patient in tribulation and steadfast in prayer while counting trials as opportunities for joy.
